### Century Communities Announces Hayden Brook Grand Opening, Offering New Homes in Cumming, GA


October 14, 2026


Versatile two-story floor plans on estate-sized homesites coming soon from the upper $600s


**KEY TAKEAWAYS**


- **New single-family homes in Cumming, GA:** Hayden Brook by Century Communities will offer 105 estate-sized homesites over three phases, with homes priced from the upper $600s.
- **Grand Opening Oct. 17:** Hayden Brook will celebrate its Grand Opening on Saturday, Oct. 17, from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m., featuring model tours, refreshments and a giveaway.
- **Two-story floor plans:** The Birch, Sapling and Hazel at Hayden Brook range from 2,987 to 3,829 square feet with 4 to 6 bedrooms, starting at $688,990.
- **Room to grow and flexible living spaces:** Every Hayden Brook floor plan includes a main-level bedroom, and select plans add a study, loft or gameroom.
- **Future amenities:** A pool, pavilion with restrooms, playground, and mail kiosk are planned for the community.
- **Assigned schools** : Schools assigned to Hayden Brook are Coal Mountain Elementary, North Forsyth Middle and North Forsyth High.
- **Convenient location** : Hayden Brook is located about three miles from GA 400 and about two miles from Matt Town Center shopping and dining.


CUMMING, Ga.


, Oct. 14, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—announced it will host a Grand Opening at Hayden Brook, the Company's anticipated new community offering single-family homes in Cumming, GA, from the upper $600s. The celebration will take place on Saturday, October 17, from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. Ahead of the Grand Opening event, Century Communities will host a ribbon-cutting and agent preview on Thursday, October 15.


**Learn more about Hayden Brook and RSVP for the Grand Opening at**[www.CenturyCommunities.com/HaydenBrookGO](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4797910-1&h=1530671470&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2FHaydenBrookGO&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2FHaydenBrookGO) **.**


"Hayden Brook gives homebuyers room to grow, with estate-sized homesites and modern floor plans that include main-level bedrooms, plus flexible living spaces like studies, lofts and gamerooms," said Tom Bowers, Atlanta Division President. "Our Grand Opening is the ideal time for interested homebuyers to tour our model home and find their best new home fit at Hayden Brook."


Homebuyers can choose from three two-story floor plans: the Birch, with 2,987 square feet, 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms; the Sapling, with 3,403 square feet, 5 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms; and the Hazel, with 3,829 square feet, 6 bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms. Every plan includes a main-level bedroom and a 2-car garage. Select plans add flexible space such as a study, loft or gameroom.


Hayden Brook is conveniently located about three miles from GA 400 and shopping centers, and about two miles from Matt Town Center's shops and restaurants. The Crossing at Coal Mountain, an upcoming retail and dining center, is less than two miles away. North Forsyth Middle and North Forsyth High, both of which are highly rated by GreatSchools, are each 1.4 miles from the community.


Matt Community Park, about three miles away, offers turf soccer fields, a playground, trails and tennis courts. Lake Lanier, Sawnee Mountain Preserve, Central Park, and Coal Mountain Park offer additional recreation nearby.


**HAYDEN BROOK | CUMMING, GA** Grand Opening on Oct. 17 | Coming soon from the upper $600s


- 105 estate-sized homesites
- Two-story floor plans from 2,987 to 3,829 square feet, with 4 to 6 bedrooms
- Open-concept layouts and flexible living spaces, with a main-level bedroom in every plan
- Future pool, pavilion with restrooms, playground, and mail kiosk
- Secondary amenity area with pocket park and trails
- Minutes from shopping and dining
- Close proximity to GA 400, shopping, and dining
- Easy access to Matt Community Park, Lake Lanier, and Sawnee Mountain Preserve
- Approximately six miles from Atlanta Cricket Fields


**Community Location** 3910 Peach Blossom Lane
Cumming, GA 30028
678.451.1017

**FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS**


**Question:** When is the Hayden Brook Grand Opening?
**Answer:** The Hayden Brook Grand Opening will be held on Saturday, Oct. 17, from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. in Cumming, GA. The celebration includes refreshments and a giveaway.


**Question:** How much do new homes cost at Hayden Brook?
**Answer:** New homes at Hayden Brook in Cumming, GA, start at $688,990. Three two-story floor plans range from 2,987 to 3,829 square feet.


**Question:** What amenities are planned at Hayden Brook in Cumming, GA?
**Answer:** Planned amenities at Hayden Brook include a pool, pavilion with restrooms, playground, and mail kiosk.


**Question:** Where is Hayden Brook located?
**Answer:** Hayden Brook is located in Cumming, GA 30028. The community model is at 3910 Peach Blossom Lane, Cumming, GA 30028.
